text: Seanan McGuire's Every Heart a Doorway was banned in 2023 in Clay County District Schools, Florida. In the same year Duval County Public Schools removed it from school libraries, with review pending for upcoming school years. In Belarus, the Ministry of Information banned the book by adding it to the Official List of Publications Harmful to National Interests, with the decision dated 2025-08-04, as documented by PEN Belarus.
meta_description: Every Heart a Doorway by Seanan McGuire: banned in Clay County, Florida and removed in Duval County in 2023; banned in Belarus in 2025.
